loans.csv.loan_id: Unique fictional loan identifier; no relationship to a real person.
loans.csv.origination_date: YYYY-MM-DD month-end; first installment due at following month-end.
loans.csv.segment: Hand-set payment-probability scenario A/B/C, not a real risk grade.
loans.csv.annual_rate: Nominal annual interest rate as a fraction; monthly rate = annual_rate / 12; excludes fees.
loans.csv.term_months: Number of contractual monthly installments (36, 48 or 60).
loans.csv.monthly_payment_usd: Unrounded level contractual installment, fictional USD.

monthly_performance.csv.observation_date: YYYY-MM-DD month-end snapshot after this month's simulated payment.
monthly_performance.csv.months_on_book: Installments scheduled since origination, starting at 1.
monthly_performance.csv.installments_paid: Whole installments paid this month, allocated oldest first; integer 0–3.
monthly_performance.csv.payment_received_usd: installments_paid * contractual monthly payment; fictional USD.
monthly_performance.csv.unpaid_installments: Count of installments remaining unpaid after allocation, including amounts due today.
monthly_performance.csv.oldest_unpaid_due_date: Oldest unpaid due date, YYYY-MM-DD; blank only when queue is empty.
monthly_performance.csv.overdue_scheduled_amount_usd: Unpaid installment count * payment; includes newly due amount. No late fees or penalty interest.
monthly_performance.csv.dpd: Calendar days since oldest unpaid due date; zero when current or only today's installment is unpaid.
monthly_performance.csv.scheduled_principal_usd: Contractual principal assuming all installments were paid on time; NOT actual principal balance.
monthly_performance.csv.dpd_bucket: Current / due today, 1–29, 30–59, 60–89, or 90+ calendar days.
